problem:
The velocity vector $v=⟨u,v⟩$ of a particle $P$ at time $t$ is given by

$$
v=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(3t+2),\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t+5)⟩,\,t>0.
$$

Calculate the acceleration vector $a.$
worked_solution:
To compute the acceleration vector, we differentiate the velocity vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3t+2)),\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t+5))⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{3}{3t+2},2\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t+5)⟩\end{aligned}
$$
